recommendation: Prioritize **billing_support**, led by **Basic Features Require Premium**. The area has 951 complaints [A4], and this issue has 365 complaints [C5] with a severity sum of 1088 [C6]. Its supplied description says free users object to restrictions on choosing songs, controlling playback, and other basic features. One reviewer says, “you can't even pick a certain song without Spotify premium” (review d146397f-4a94-4980-be00-ae9212eca3a7); another says basic features now require payment and reports uninstalling (review f56c4cf1-e30c-4a98-95f8-c327304870e4). Compare usability: it has 1,163 complaints [A2], but the supplied lead ad issue describes interruptions rather than restrictions on basic controls. Playback has 759 complaints [A3]; its general issue has a higher mean severity of 3.295019 [C19], but fewer complaints at 261 [C17]. Those are credible alternatives, but billing_support leads on area-level complaint volume, while the free-tier issue offers a concrete product focus. Treat this as a prioritization signal, not evidence of business impact: public reviewers self-select, and stated intent to uninstall is not observed churn.
